hints.title: Instruction Pointer Simulation
hints.text: Simulate the movement of a pointer across instructions while maintaining an accumulated total score.

hints.title: Visited Tracking
hints.text: Keep track of visited instruction indices to terminate execution if an index is revisited.

hints.title: Boundary Checking
hints.text: Stop simulation whenever the index steps outside the valid range.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each instruction is visited at most once before termination.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without tracking visited indices, cyclic instruction loops cause infinite execution.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A boolean tracking array prevents repeated visits with linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement linear simulation while detecting cycle termination conditions.
